events.title: Demo for CygamesEdge's Debut Title, Where the Seeds Fall, Available Today
events.summary: The demo for Where the Seeds Fall launches today on Steam®, featuring a challenging section built to showcase the game's mechanics and aspects of descent. The demo has all actions unlocked from the start, contains no story elements, and can be completed in about 15 to 30 minutes.The full game features a stronger emphasis on narrative and lore, with actions being gradually unlocked as players progress through the story. events.title: Make Your Descent in Where The Seeds Fall, Coming November 5, 2026
events.summary: Test your footing, read the wind, and take leaps of faith in CygamesEdge's debut title, Where the Seeds Fall, a thrilling action-adventure descent through towering challenges coming November 5, 2026.The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree. events.title: Introducing CygamesEdge
events.summary: CygamesEdge is a new brand under Cygames dedicated to empowering small and mid-sized teams filled with innovative ideas and the drive to bring groundbreaking experiences to players everywhere. Under the tagline "Stay on the edge," CygamesEdge draws on the game development expertise Cygames has cultivated over the years, channeling it into innovative titles built on strong core mechanics and state-of-the-art technology.
